subject: Ds004's four decisions and the procedures room
decision: The commander liked the dossier and is happy to go with the pilot's calls. So, per the pilot's recommendations in Ds004: (1) the Ds002 reversal stands, no team mines for new records and the topic store is a fine-tuning source; (2) the commander reads the four stubs before they land; (3) the Validated line carries the team id and seat; (4) the label is Validated. On the procedures room: leave out the fc-surveyor; a basic scaffold with some starting procedures; flightcrew procedures are built after the cockpit fitout and the self-sustaining work settle (order Or042).
